annotations.title: Open a vote for the pass holders of an event (hosts and organizers only)

description: Opens a vote for the people who added the event pass. Needs the event, a question and the options, as many as you name; the only limit is technical. One vote per pass, changeable until the vote closes, secret: counts only, never who. Without confirm it returns the number of passes and the exact line and sends nothing; with confirm true it opens the vote and puts the line on every pass. quiet true puts the line on the pass with no lock-screen alert. It counts against the notice limits: six an hour per event and Google's alerts per pass per day.

confirm.description: Absent previews; true opens the vote.

eventIdOrName.description: The event id or name as the organizer spells it.

options.description: The options, one plain line each, as many as you name. At least two.

question.description: One plain line. No links or markup.

quiet.description: True: no lock-screen alert. Default false.

requestId.description: Optional caller id; one id opens once.
